title: Speaking Practice 4 - Work and Study
description: IELTS Speaking Part 1: Questions about work, study and daily life.

stimuli.title: Part 1: Work and Study
stimuli.content: In this part, the examiner asks you questions about yourself and familiar topics.

questionGroups.instruction: Answer the following questions about work and study.

questions.content: Do you work or are you a student?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I'm currently a third-year university student majoring in Computer Science at FPT University.
explanation.tips: State clearly and add one detail

questions.content: Why did you choose that subject?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I chose Computer Science because I've always been fascinated by how technology can solve real-world problems.
explanation.tips: Give a reason with personal connection

questions.content: What do you plan to do after graduation?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I plan to work as a software developer for a few years and then possibly start my own tech company.

questions.content: Do you prefer studying alone or in a group?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I prefer studying in a group for complex topics because discussing ideas helps me understand better.

questions.content: What time of day do you study best?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I'm definitely a night owl. I find I can concentrate much better late at night when it's quiet.
explanation.tips: Be specific about when and why
